status: prospective protocol, no restoration model downloaded/loaded or run
purpose: Test whether pretrained face restoration can improve photographic detail from our genuinely trained priest GAN, without accepting malformed raw samples or disguising exclusions.
inputs: All32 raw-psi1 images from fixed625 matched evaluation, indices000–031, unfiltered. Keep all original images.
evaluation_design: Run one pinned official CPU restoration recipe after NADA terminal. Preserve every output and failure; no retries or manual seed selection.
Compare face anatomy, eye/skin detail, clerical collar and image boundaries at actual displayed size; especially severe raw architectural failures and hat-like outputs.
Any learned/hallucinated detail is generated refinement, not recovered evidence; exact identity preservation is not a user requirement.
Keep restoration quality separate from raw-sample rejection. Catastrophic heads and hats remain failures even if a detector or restoration produces a plausible face.
Record end-to-end timing/memory including actual face detection and compositing; quantify rejection rate only after a separately specified gate is evaluated.
A positive32-case diagnostic would justify new unseen latent end-to-end testing, not production deployment.
serving_contract: Fresh random latent -> trained priest generator -> independently evaluated quality/headwear gate -> restoration if validated -> new uncached image. No finite seed bank or generated image cache.
